It's great work! I can run Alpamayo 1.5 normally without enabling use_classifier_free_guidance_nav. However, when I set driver.model.use_classifier_free_guidance_nav=true to activate the classifier-free guidance navigation feature, I immediately get the error:ValueError: <|route_start|> not found in input_ids

3. Does the default scene support this navigation feature? Do I need a dedicated navigation-enabled scene config?
4. What are the full prerequisites and configuration steps to enable classifier-free guidance navigation correctly?

Thank you very much for your help!

comments.body:
Thanks for the detailed report. I traced this and the error is expected with the current public AlpaSim integration.

At the moment there is no public AlpaSim wizard/config option for supplying A1.5  language navigation text.
and the tutorial command enabling CFG navigation is misleading in the current release. 

So for now please run Alpamayo 1.5 with:  `driver.model.use_classifier_free_guidance_nav=false` until actual plumbing implements.

Root cause: this is an AlpaSim integration/docs gap, not a user config mistake.

FYI :  To run this inference with CFG(classifier free guidance), you will need 60GB+ GPU memory. so even if plumbing is done, make sure you have 60GB+ GPU memory to test this.  refer to https://github.com/NVlabs/alpamayo1.5/blob/main/notebooks/inference_nav.ipynb
